Former Players Predict Arsenal vs Chelsea Premier League Clash

Former England defender Gary Neville predicted the upcoming Premier League match between Arsenal and Chelsea, calling it a tough derby test for the champions. Former Newcastle striker Alan Shearer also gave his forecast for the fixture. Former Chelsea captain John Terry said Chelsea could expose Arsenal in the game. The match is described as a key test of Chelsea's title credentials after their championship win. No official line‑ups have been confirmed, and the reports only contain the pundits' predictions.
